title: Soundef PlaybackPlan v0
description: Resolved playback plan — deterministic output of Soundef Core (definition + seed → plan). Keys match schemas/soundef.v0.json (gain/pitch/offset bare). Units fixed: gain dB, pitch st, offset ms.

seed.description: Seed used for this resolve. Preserves original type string|number.

layers.description: Resolved layers in declaration order. Skipped layers are kept with skipped:true for ghost timeline.

effects.description: Resolved post-layer FX. Only present when definition declares effects.

reverbAmount.description: Reverb send 0..1, lerped from range via isolated seed#reverb stream.

source.description: Resolved source file after glob expansion (e.g. swords/body_01.wav).

offset.description: Delay from trigger in milliseconds. Parsed from ms string or randomRange ms. 0 if omitted.

gain.description: Gain in decibels (dB). Parsed from dB string or randomRange dB.

pitch.description: Pitch shift in semitones (st). Parsed from st string or randomRange st.

probabilityRoll.description: RNG roll [0,1) used for probability check, if layer had probability.

skipped.description: True when probability roll failed — playback and bake ignore it, timeline shows ghost.

unitValue.description: Reserved wrapper for future typed gain/pitch/offset if runtime demands type-safe units. Not used in v0 bare plan — kept to avoid re-introducing gainDb drift.
